capabilities.title: Bounded Hypermid v1 framing
capabilities.behavior: All clients encode a four-byte big-endian JSON length, reject frames above 8 MiB before body allocation, and stream payload chunks no larger than 64 KiB.
acceptance: Golden frames are byte-identical in all four clients.
Oversized declarations fail before body allocation.

capabilities.title: Capability negotiation
capabilities.behavior: A client learns protocol limits, transport, lifecycle, operations, effects, scope needs, resume support, and adapter coverage before using other operations.
acceptance: Unimplemented actions are absent or carry a typed unavailable reason.
Unknown additive capabilities do not break older clients.

capabilities.title: Python Gideon HostAdapter
capabilities.behavior: The essential Python client maps Gideon owner, project, workspace, session, model, credential, lifecycle, and cursor concepts to daemon contracts.
acceptance: Unprovable scope translation fails before dispatch.
The negotiated full-host flag is true only when every required family is present.

capabilities.title: Rust, TypeScript, and Swift client parity
capabilities.behavior: Generic clients share request, response, event, error, chunk, cursor, cancellation, reconnect, and outcome semantics while keeping idiomatic APIs.
acceptance: Each client passes the same wire vectors.
Each client preserves unknown additive fields and typed effect outcomes.

capabilities.title: Authenticated reconnect and cursor resume
capabilities.behavior: Reconnect performs a fresh handshake and negotiation, resumes only within the accepted epoch, and never retries a possibly accepted mutation automatically.
acceptance: A wrong-epoch cursor is refused visibly.
A post-write disconnect returns outcome unknown without automatic retry.

capabilities.title: Scoped session browser
capabilities.behavior: Users filter active, closed, archived, and unhealthy sessions by scope, lifecycle, model, time, and text within the native console.
acceptance: Filters retain separate query identities from the complete list.
Unavailable and empty states are distinguishable.

capabilities.title: Cursored session timeline
capabilities.behavior: A session detail orders turns, tools, memory, caches, compaction, errors, and traces by authoritative epoch and sequence.
acceptance: Snapshot adoption plus replay renders each terminal item once.
An unrecoverable cursor gap is announced and displayed.

capabilities.title: Memory evidence inspector
capabilities.behavior: Memory detail links scope, revisions, lineage, sources, verification, contradictions, vectors, retrieval scores, and maintenance jobs.
acceptance: Anchors and revisable summaries are labeled distinctly.
Unauthorized suppressed candidates reveal counts without content.

capabilities.title: Conflict-safe memory editing
capabilities.behavior: Edits carry the displayed revision and digest; refusal preserves the draft and offers compare, reload, or reapply.
acceptance: A stale write does not alter the authoritative record.
The rejected draft remains recoverable.

capabilities.title: Cache and projection inspector
capabilities.behavior: Cache rows expose scope, kind, generation, input digest, size, age, hit/miss counts, and freshness with plan-first clear or rebuild actions.
acceptance: Fresh, stale, rebuilding, unavailable, and unreadable are distinct.
Clear and rebuild show exact affected scope before apply.

capabilities.title: Revisioned runtime configuration
capabilities.behavior: Runtime settings show effective value, source, editability, restart requirement, validation, and paired revision; mode is exactly off, pass_through, shadow, or primary while strictness is a separate policy field.
acceptance: Mode and strictness round-trip as separate fields and validation runs before apply.
A stale refusal retains dirty values and their original revision context.

capabilities.title: Model discovery and binding
capabilities.behavior: Model controls show provider, readiness, dimensions, bindings, residency, and last real probe without inventing unknown metadata.
acceptance: Binding preview names affected duties.
Ready appears only after the required live probe passes.

capabilities.title: One-way credential controls
capabilities.behavior: Credential surfaces expose name, scope, backend, presence, validation time, and consumers while accepting values only on write.
acceptance: No read path returns a credential value.
Delete preview names affected consumers and requires confirmation.

capabilities.title: Observed diagnostics
capabilities.behavior: Diagnostics covers daemon, store, adapter, transport, clients, child processes, models, indexes, and recent typed failures with timestamps and next actions.
acceptance: Cached checks are labeled with their observation time.
A failed rerun leaves the prior observation visible and reports the failure.

capabilities.title: Redacted resumable logs
capabilities.behavior: Bounded logs filter by severity, component, scope, session, trace, and time; pause affects viewport only and reconnect resumes or exposes a gap.
acceptance: Secrets are redacted before persistence, streaming, copy, and export.
A cursor outside retention produces a visible gap.

capabilities.title: Maintenance planning
capabilities.behavior: Integrity, reconciliation, reindex, compaction, cleanup, and rebuild actions begin with a scoped, expiring, digest-covered plan.
acceptance: The plan names budgets, blockers, destructive effects, and restart needs.
Expired, altered, or differently scoped plans cannot apply.

capabilities.title: Cursored maintenance progress and receipts
capabilities.behavior: Applied work streams ordered progress and ends with a durable committed, failed, cancelled, or outcome-unknown receipt.
acceptance: Cancellation cannot overwrite a committed receipt.
Reconnect restores progress or the terminal receipt by cursor and job id.

capabilities.title: Install journey
capabilities.behavior: Install checks platform, directories, permissions, service wiring, protected connection material, and ownership before any write.
acceptance: Dry review and apply use the same plan digest.
A blocker prevents every planned write.

capabilities.title: Update and rollback journey
capabilities.behavior: Update verifies candidate identity, compatibility floors, migration needs, free space, drain behavior, and rollback material before apply.
acceptance: Active work drains or produces an explicit blocker.
Rollback is offered only when the receipt proves it is available.

capabilities.title: Uninstall with explicit data disposition
capabilities.behavior: Uninstall inventories service wiring, runtime files, configuration, and user data separately and requires retain, export, or purge selection.
acceptance: A retain or export plan cannot purge data.
A purge requires current owner authority and fresh confirmation.

capabilities.title: Staged migration
capabilities.behavior: Migration validates authoritative records in staging, shows conflicts and unsupported rows, and publishes idempotently only after review.
acceptance: Rejected rows remain inspectable without partial visibility.
Repeating the same migration creates no duplicate authoritative record.

capabilities.title: Verified export
capabilities.behavior: Export previews scope, inclusions, exclusions, destination, and estimate, then returns a manifest digest and byte count.
acceptance: The artifact digest verifies before success is shown.
Vectors, indexes, credentials, and local authentication material are absent.

capabilities.title: Scoped MCP tool bridge
capabilities.behavior: The bridge exposes an authorized catalog and tool-call path for memory, search, sessions, and diagnostics without implicit lifecycle or credential authority.
acceptance: Tool schemas and errors round-trip faithfully.
The bridge is labeled Tool bridge and leaves full-host status false.

capabilities.title: Full host integration status
capabilities.behavior: The surface reports full-host readiness only when identity, scope, sessions, memory, configuration, credentials, lifecycle, cursors, and reconnect are all negotiated.
acceptance: Missing families are enumerated without fabricated availability.
Adding tool calls alone never changes the full-host flag.

capabilities.title: Supervised stdio process lifecycle
capabilities.behavior: Configured children start lazily with an allowlisted environment and bounded initialization, request, frame, idle, retry, shutdown, and reap behavior.
acceptance: A wedged child cannot block health or another child.
Cancellation after write tears down the child and reports outcome unknown without retry.

capabilities.title: Fenced file conditions
capabilities.behavior: Declarative path existence, file content, and modification-time predicates canonicalize and revalidate the target within authorized roots.
acceptance: Symlink escape is refused before reading content.
State transitions produce stable occurrence identities without duplicate events.

capabilities.title: Bounded git conditions
capabilities.behavior: Commit ancestry and tag predicates use argument-vector execution, verify repository identity and refs, and return bounded facts without raw command output.
acceptance: Repository identity or ref changes before publication are refused.
Shell syntax, network access, excessive output, and deadline overrun cannot execute as a condition.

capabilities.title: Opt-in TLS device enrollment
capabilities.behavior: Remote access requires TLS, a named device, least-privilege Scope, capability review, and expiry; revocation blocks new sessions.
acceptance: Missing TLS or enrollment fails closed.
The client never downgrades to an unauthenticated transport.

capabilities.title: Mobile operator layout
capabilities.behavior: The native route uses one-column inspection, a filter sheet, persistent status, and review actions suitable for foreground and resumed mobile sessions.
acceptance: 320px and 390px journeys have no horizontal page scrolling.
Backgrounding and reconnect restore the authoritative job receipt.

capabilities.title: Accessible operator interaction
capabilities.behavior: All status, filter, timeline, dialog, plan, progress, and receipt interactions support keyboard, screen reader, touch, and reduced motion.
acceptance: Validation, gaps, and terminal outcomes are announced once with visible focus preserved.
Touch targets are at least 44px and dense data has a linear alternative.

capabilities.title: Native Gideon console destination
capabilities.behavior: Hypermid lives in Gideon's existing settings and diagnostics information architecture and reuses shared navigation, headers, cards, forms, tables, and dialogs.
acceptance: No standalone web application is required or started.
A user completes inspect, configure, plan, apply, and receipt recovery without raw identifiers or JSON.

capabilities.title: Human and JSON CLI
capabilities.behavior: CLI commands cover status, inspect, config, maintenance, lifecycle, conditions, and export with stable exit classes and non-interactive safety.
acceptance: Human and JSON modes represent the same authoritative result.
Non-interactive input never blocks on a prompt and mutation requires explicit apply data.

capabilities.title: Desktop lifecycle ownership
capabilities.behavior: The existing desktop shell starts and stops the local daemon only in local mode, hands off shutdown cleanly, and exposes native status and notifications.
acceptance: Local shutdown leaves no orphaned daemon-owned stdio child.
Web-only mode reports local operations unavailable and does not start a local daemon.

capabilities.title: Truthful implementation state
capabilities.behavior: Every client and surface distinguishes unavailable, planned, connecting, ready, degraded, running, committed, failed, cancelled, and outcome unknown.
acceptance: A schema or rendered control never appears as installed or ready evidence.
Disconnected progress never becomes a successful terminal state without a receipt.
